hooks.name: Contract sync
hooks.description: After Kiro edits a file under backend/app/schemas/, regenerate OpenAPI and note the change for the frontend.

action.prompt:
Contract sync hook. Apply ONLY if the file you just edited is under backend/app/schemas/. Otherwise ignore this hook.

1. Run: make openapi. Report errors and fix them.
2. Add one line under the "Changes" heading in docs/FRONTEND_REQUESTS.md (create the file or heading if missing) describing the schema change: date, model and field names (camelCase as on the wire), and whether it is additive or breaking.
